title: Charge the full unconditional programme and controller error
statement: A known offline parallel prestate with source marginal rho has iid-Choi simulation using Q*ceil(chi/delta) copies, chi=k^Q||rho||op; chi=1 gives exact Q-copy simulation. Known product blocks of width<=b admit one finite common-frame Bell queue of at most ceil(Q k^(2b)/delta) copies. Known-matrix filters improve copy counts only with their acquisition paid. Retries share the same preacquired frame pool, and complete decoding error is e+delta+zeta including finite-controller budget, not just a selected success branch.

requires: Actual known offline parallel prestate/source marginal or supplied bounded-width product probes
